title: Two-tape table serialization
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $\mathrm{tr}$ assign an action on two Boolean work tapes to each state in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$, each optional Boolean input symbol, and each pair of optional Boolean symbols read on the work tapes. Serialize the complete transition table by listing, for every state and every such input and pair of work-tape reads, the action bits prescribed by $\mathrm{tr}$. This list is exactly the two-tape table encoding obtained by supplying the two work-tape symbols separately to $\mathrm{tr}$.
hypotheses_covered: $\mathrm{tr}$ has the stated domain and returns actions with two work tapes and states in $\{0,\ldots,n\}$
